'''Station 300''' was an outpost that was established by the [[Shorak]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Giaca]], during their attempts to colonize the world. However, their colony was unsuccessful and they eventually abandoned Station 300, leaving it to the few criminals and visitors that made their way to Giaca. About twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Shorak returned to Giaca and expanded Station 300, and they re-named it '''Station 3Z3'''. By the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the station had been fortified, enabling it to support a permanent colony, which numbered 50,000 individuals by the fall of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] during the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. However, the colony regularly fell under attack from the Shorak's rivals, the [[Peroenian]]s.<ref name="TUR" />
